English: Stone Bench
A rough semicircle of stone benches, hastily arranged for settlers to gather and settle disputes or make announcements. Provides a modest boost to local order and tax collection.
Judgement Shade
A broad awning or tree-shaded area with stone seats where disputes are heard and minor contracts sealed. Encourages civic engagement and modestly increases tax and garrison.
Meeting Platform
A sturdy wooden platform raised above the ground, serving as a focal point for town meetings and minor trade. Slightly improves local prosperity and city defense.
Debate Circle
A stone-paved open circle with permanent seating for citizens and notables to debate civic issues, improving administration, trade, and security. Requires basic city construction techniques.
Council Terrace
An elevated stone terrace overlooking the plaza, reserved for city council and notables. Strongly boosts tax collection, trade, and begins to attract scholars. Requires city construction II.
Verdict Hall

A grand, roofed hall built of stone, where major civic decisions and disputes are settled. Drastically improves city tax, trade, and administration, and further increases garrison security. Requires city construction III.
Advisors' Gallery

A two-tiered gallery for advisors, scribes, and important citizens, allowing for administration of city affairs and complex trade arrangements. Provides major boosts to tax, trade, and technological progress.
Assembly Portico

A colonnaded portico enclosing the assembly complex, providing shelter, storage for records, and space for merchants. Vastly increases tax efficiency, trade, and city defense. Requires advanced construction and city status.
Wise Mens Court

A majestic chamber for the wisest elders, councilors, and scribes, facilitating advanced governance and attracting trade. Profoundly boosts tax, trade, technology, and provides immense civic security.
Grand Assembly Plaza

A vast, fully paved civic plaza surrounded by imposing structures for governance, trade, and gatherings. The zenith of urban civic achievement: unmatched tax, trade, and technological prosperity, with formidable urban defense.
